TextEditor is a text editor for Android. Edit, search, replace, and save text files on your device.

The last opened file is reopened on startup. This loads the saved file; it is not a backup of unsaved changes. Files explicitly opened from another app take priority.

Files are read and written as UTF-8. LF, CRLF, and CR line endings are supported, along with recent files, light/dark themes, and auto-save.

Use the file icon at the top to select New or Open. After editing, select Save. Choose a location when saving a new file.\n\nUse Save as to create another file. Reload reads the saved content again. Operations that discard unsaved changes require confirmation.

From left to right: Open, New, Undo, Redo, Find and replace, Previous match, Next match, Save, and Clear text.

The × on the right clears the text after confirmation. The file name and save location are retained. Undo restores the text. When auto-save is enabled, clearing the text also counts as a change to save.

The pencil icon focuses the editor and opens the keyboard. The More menu includes Go to line, Statistics, Share, and Read-only.

Use the search icon or Find and replace in the More menu. Enter text and choose Match case, Regular expression, and Wrap around as needed.

For regular expressions, searching for (\d+) and replacing with [$1] wraps numbers in brackets. Expressions beginning with * use wildcard matching; *.txt finds file names.

Matches and errors appear in an on-screen notice. Use its × to dismiss it.

Select Recent files from the navigation menu to view names, paths or links, and last opened times. Select an entry to reopen it.

To allow local file access, use the permission action in Recent files or File access in Settings. Cloud files require individual access grants.

If a file was moved, deleted, or its permission expired, grant access or select the file again. Recent files does not store a backup of the text.

Open Settings from the navigation menu to choose light/dark mode, line numbers, word wrap, font size, and line spacing.

Line ending, tab, and space symbols can be shown. LF uses ← and CRLF uses ↵. Display symbols are not added to the saved text.

Zoom in the More menu accepts 25–400 percent. Pinch to zoom is available only when enabled in Settings; it is off by default.

At the bottom of Settings, use Language to choose 日本語 or English. The choice is retained after restarting the app.
Enable Auto-save in Settings to save after the chosen delay following the last edit. The delay is 1–10 minutes. For new files, first choose a location by saving manually.

Files with the .md extension open in preview automatically (case-insensitive). Select Edit or use Back to return to the editor. Select Markdown preview to render unsaved text again. Switching modes does not change text, cursor position, or unsaved status.\n\nHeadings, lists, quotes, code, tables, strikethrough, and links are supported. HTML is displayed as text; images and scripts are not loaded. HTTP/HTTPS links open in an external browser after confirmation. Relative links and images, task lists, and math are not supported.
